static_checks.message: Local MEDDPICC scores are retired as current evidence; qualification routes to grill
Dates must come from datetime.now(tz=UTC), not date.today()
The script must declare PyYAML rather than assume the system Python has it
Must keep the read-only default and per-pursuit approval
Must distinguish itself from the single-file CLI command
pursuit health reports paths relative to accounts/; the script must prefix them
pursuit health exits 1 with valid rows when some files are damaged; the script must keep the rows and report the rest

evals.prompt: are my pursuit files still in line with salesforce?
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the session preflight, then the read-only drift script, and presents every in-scope opportunity RED first
assertions: Runs fieldkit sf session-check before fetching anything
Presents RED opportunities before YELLOW and GREEN
Does not write any pursuit file without approval

evals.prompt: sf-reconcile for {{primary_account}} — the salesforce session expired
evals.expected_behavior: Stops at preflight and asks the operator to re-authenticate instead of reporting cached data
assertions: Instructs the operator to run 'fieldkit auth sf'
Does not present stored frontmatter as current Salesforce data

evals.prompt: sf-reconcile flagged stage-mismatch on {{primary_pursuit}}, just fix it
evals.expected_behavior: Treats local stage as operator judgment and asks rather than changing it
assertions: Does not edit the local stage field on its own
Points to pursuit-advance or asks the operator for the stage decision
